title: Cardiac instability
synopsis: Respiratory stress can trigger ectopy, VT, ICD therapy, hypotension, or recurrent arrest risk. Treatment limits discussions must be accessible and must not imply disability reduces worthiness of escalation. Seeded for Episode 02; linked from Episode 01 debrief hook.
openingNarrative: Rohan’s cardiomyopathy and ICD history mean respiratory manoeuvres are never only respiratory. Ectopy may cluster when pressures climb or recruitment is aggressive. Approaches include treating reversible respiratory triggers first, escalating circulatory support, or limiting additional burdens unless instability worsens—always with Rohan addressed directly when access exists.
clinicalState: Severe cardiomyopathy. ICD in situ. Limited cardiac reserve post prolonged arrest. Arrhythmia burden sensitive to respiratory stress.
disabilityRightsNotes: Disability does not make escalation less worthwhile.
Limits talk requires accessible communication—not family proxy first.
ICD therapy is clinical event, not spectacle.
debriefNotes: Episode 01 Branch C previews this phase.
Next-episode hook from ep01-debrief-hook lands here.

nodes.title: Ectopy under respiratory stress
nodes.openingNarrative: Ventricular ectopy rises after an airway manoeuvre. The ICD paces. Blood pressure softens. Choose the emphasis.
nodes.clinicalState: Ectopy cluster. Soft BP. Airway still imperfect. AAC fatigued but available.

choices.label: Treat reversible respiratory triggers first while monitoring rhythm
choices.immediateConsequence: Airway focus may settle ectopy; delay in pure cardiac escalation.
choices.delayedConsequence: If trigger persists, arrhythmia returns—legitimate uncertainty.
choices.rohanAacLine: EVERY ALARM STILL DESERVES AN ANSWER.

choices.label: Escalate cardiac and circulatory support now
choices.immediateConsequence: Perfusion support rises; treatment burden and monitoring intensity rise.
choices.delayedConsequence: Must still explain actions to Rohan accessibly.

choices.label: Limit additional burdens unless instability worsens — with Rohan in the loop
choices.immediateConsequence: Authorship protected; risk of under-escalation if instability accelerates.
choices.delayedConsequence: Documentation must not imply disability-based undertreatment.

disabilityRightsNotes: Any limits discussion is about burdens and goals—not worth of a disabled life.

nodes.title: After the first cardiac choice
nodes.openingNarrative: Instability eases or persists. Bridge toward sedation/communication work or home planning depending on episode wiring.

choices.label: Continue into sedation and communication restoration
choices.delayedConsequence: Cardiac domain remains elevated in debrief.

choices.label: Keep cardiac plan and open home/school continuity
choices.delayedConsequence: Dates move; membership does not vanish.
choices.rohanAacLine: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

choices.label: Park as Episode 02 opening state
choices.immediateConsequence: Forest marker for later playable episode.
choices.delayedConsequence: Debrief hook from Episode 01 points here.
choices.rohanAacLine: THE AMBULANCE KEPT THE CODE GOING.

disabilityRightsNotes: Cardiac phase does not end the story at ROSC.
